name: RenownAppProfile
description: The public profile of an app identity (did:key) and the publisher who maintains it

global.schema:
type RenownAppProfileState {
  appDid: String
  publisherDid: String
  name: String
  tagline: String
  "Legacy logo: an https URL or a raster data URL; logoRef wins when set"
  logo: String
  website: String
  "Markdown subset, at most 2000 characters; rendered sanitized"
  description: String
  "At most 40 characters"
  category: String
  "Uploaded square logo"
  logoRef: AttachmentRef
  "Uploaded 3:1 cover image"
  coverRef: AttachmentRef
  "At most 8 links, in display order"
  links: [RenownAppLink!]!
  "Publisher-defined metrics, at most 16, in display order"
  metrics: [RenownAppMetric!]!
}

type RenownAppLink {
  id: OID!
  label: String!
  url: URL!
}

enum RenownMetricAggregation {
  SUM
  MAX
  AVG
  COUNT_USERS
}

type RenownAppMetric {
  id: OID!
  "The metric name the app reports: ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$"
  key: String!
  "1-40 characters"
  label: String!
  "At most 16 characters, e.g. notes"
  unit: String
  "At most 200 characters"
  description: String
  aggregation: RenownMetricAggregation!
  "Shown on the app page and on user profiles"
  public: Boolean!
}
global.initialValue:
{
  "appDid": null,
  "publisherDid": null,
  "name": null,
  "tagline": null,
  "logo": null,
  "website": null,
  "description": null,
  "category": null,
  "logoRef": null,
  "coverRef": null,
  "links": [],
  "metrics": []
}

operations.name: SET_APP_DID
operations.description: Binds the profile to its app DID. Set once; repeating the same DID is a no-op.

errors.name: InvalidAppDidError
errors.description: The app DID is not a did:key DID

errors.name: AppDidImmutableError
errors.description: The profile already belongs to another app DID

operations.name: SET_PUBLISHER_DID
operations.description: Records the publisher (a did:pkh:eip155 wallet DID) who maintains the profile.

errors.name: InvalidPublisherDidError
errors.description: The publisher DID is not a did:pkh:eip155 DID

operations.name: SET_PROFILE
operations.description: Patches the public fields. A null or absent field is unchanged; an empty string clears it.
operations.schema:
input SetProfileInput {
  name: String
  tagline: String
  logo: String
  website: String
  "Markdown subset, at most 2000 characters; empty clears"
  description: String
  "At most 40 characters; empty clears"
  category: String
  "attachment://v1:<sha256>; empty clears"
  logoRef: String
  "attachment://v1:<sha256>; empty clears"
  coverRef: String
}

errors.name: AppDidNotSetError
errors.description: SET_APP_DID must run before the profile is edited

errors.name: InvalidWebsiteError
errors.description: The website is not an http(s) URL

errors.name: InvalidLogoError
errors.description: The logo is neither an https URL nor a base64 image data URL

errors.name: DescriptionTooLongError
errors.description: The description is longer than 2000 characters

errors.name: CategoryTooLongError
errors.description: The category is longer than 40 characters

errors.name: InvalidImageRefError
errors.description: logoRef or coverRef is not an attachment://v1:<64 lowercase hex> reference

operations.name: ADD_LINK
operations.schema:
input AddLinkInput {
  id: OID!
  "1-40 characters after trimming"
  label: String!
  "http(s) URL, at most 2048 characters"
  url: URL!
}

errors.name: DuplicateLinkIdError
errors.description: A link with this id already exists

errors.name: InvalidLinkError
errors.description: The label is blank or longer than 40 characters, or the URL is not an http(s) URL of at most 2048 characters

operations.name: UPDATE_LINK
operations.description: Changes the label and/or URL of a link

errors.name: LinkNotFoundError
errors.description: No link with this id exists

operations.name: REORDER_LINKS
operations.description: Moves the listed links to the front in the given order; unlisted links keep their relative order after them

modules.name: metrics
modules.description: Publisher-defined metrics: what the app reports and how Renown aggregates and shows it

operations.name: ADD_METRIC
operations.description: Declares a metric at the end of the list
operations.schema:
input AddMetricInput {
  id: OID!
  "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$, unique per app"
  key: String!
  "1-40 characters after trimming"
  label: String!
  "At most 16 characters; empty means none"
  unit: String
  "At most 200 characters; empty means none"
  description: String
  aggregation: RenownMetricAggregation!
  public: Boolean!
}

errors.name: DuplicateMetricIdError
errors.description: A metric with this id already exists

errors.name: DuplicateMetricKeyError
errors.description: Another metric already uses this key

errors.name: InvalidMetricError
errors.description: The key does not match the metric rule, or the label, unit or description is out of bounds

operations.name: UPDATE_METRIC
operations.description: Changes fields of a metric; absent fields are unchanged, an empty unit or description clears it
operations.schema:
input UpdateMetricInput {
  id: OID!
  key: String
  label: String
  unit: String
  description: String
  aggregation: RenownMetricAggregation
  public: Boolean
}

errors.name: MetricNotFoundError
errors.description: No metric with this id exists

operations.name: REMOVE_METRIC
operations.description: Removes a metric definition (reported values are kept)

operations.name: REORDER_METRICS
operations.description: Moves the listed metrics to the front in the given order; unlisted metrics keep their relative order after them
